_note: Japan Live Games tab. The app shows games in this order, features `featured`, and hides any with enabled:false. Keys must match a game built into the app: sudoku, nonogram, shisensho, reversi, gomoku, 2048, snake, ttt. New puzzles for Sudoku and Picture Logic come from the feeds below, so you can add puzzles without an app update.
